From 895f7b8e90200cf1a5dc313329369adf30e51f9a Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Juergen Gross <jgross@suse.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Feb 2018 14:46:09 -0800
Subject: [PATCH] mm: don't defer struct page initialization for Xen pv guests

Commit f7f99100d8d9 ("mm: stop zeroing memory during allocation in
vmemmap") broke Xen pv domains in some configurations, as the "Pinned"
information in struct page of early page tables could get lost.

This will lead to the kernel trying to write directly into the page
tables instead of asking the hypervisor to do so.  The result is a crash
like the following:

  BUG: unable to handle kernel paging request at ffff8801ead19008
  IP: xen_set_pud+0x4e/0xd0
  PGD 1c0a067 P4D 1c0a067 PUD 23a0067 PMD 1e9de0067 PTE 80100001ead19065
  Oops: 0003 [#1] PREEMPT SMP
  Modules linked in:
  CPU: 0 PID: 0 Comm: swapper/0 Not tainted 4.14.0-default+ #271
  Hardware name: Dell Inc. Latitude E6440/0159N7, BIOS A07 06/26/2014
  task: ffffffff81c10480 task.stack: ffffffff81c00000
  RIP: e030:xen_set_pud+0x4e/0xd0
  Call Trace:
   __pmd_alloc+0x128/0x140
   ioremap_page_range+0x3f4/0x410
   __ioremap_caller+0x1c3/0x2e0
   acpi_os_map_iomem+0x175/0x1b0
   acpi_tb_acquire_table+0x39/0x66
   acpi_tb_validate_table+0x44/0x7c
   acpi_tb_verify_temp_table+0x45/0x304
   acpi_reallocate_root_table+0x12d/0x141
   acpi_early_init+0x4d/0x10a
   start_kernel+0x3eb/0x4a1
   xen_start_kernel+0x528/0x532
  Code: 48 01 e8 48 0f 42 15 a2 fd be 00 48 01 d0 48 ba 00 00 00 00 00 ea ff ff 48 c1 e8 0c 48 c1 e0 06 48 01 d0 48 8b 00 f6 c4 02 75 5d <4c> 89 65 00 5b 5d 41 5c c3 65 8b 05 52 9f fe 7e 89 c0 48 0f a3
  RIP: xen_set_pud+0x4e/0xd0 RSP: ffffffff81c03cd8
  CR2: ffff8801ead19008
  
diff --git a/mm/page_alloc.c b/mm/page_alloc.c
index 81e18ceef579..cb416723538f 100644
--- a/mm/page_alloc.c
+++ b/mm/page_alloc.c
@@ -46,6 +46,7 @@
 #include <linux/stop_machine.h>
 #include <linux/sort.h>
 #include <linux/pfn.h>
+#include <xen/xen.h>
 #include <linux/backing-dev.h>
 #include <linux/fault-inject.h>
 #include <linux/page-isolation.h>
@@ -347,6 +348,9 @@ static inline bool update_defer_init(pg_data_t *pgdat,
 	/* Always populate low zones for address-constrained allocations */
 	if (zone_end < pgdat_end_pfn(pgdat))
 		return true;
+	/* Xen PV domains need page structures early */
+	if (xen_pv_domain())
+		return true;
 	(*nr_initialised)++;
 	if ((*nr_initialised > pgdat->static_init_pgcnt) &&
 	    (pfn & (PAGES_PER_SECTION - 1)) == 0) {
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `mm/page_alloc.c`**
   - Added an include directive for `<xen/xen.h>`.
   - Modified the `update_defer_init` function to include a condition that checks if the system is a Xen PV (paravirtualized) domain. If it is, the function will return `true`, indicating that page structures need to be initialized early.

### Relationships Between Modifications

The modification in `mm/page_alloc.c` addresses a specific issue related to Xen PV domains that arose from a previous commit. By ensuring that the page structures are initialized early for Xen PV domains, the patch prevents the loss of "Pinned" information in the `struct page` of early page tables. This change is crucial to avoid kernel crashes that occur when the kernel attempts to write directly into page tables instead of delegating that task to the hypervisor. Thus, the relationship between the modifications is that the new condition directly mitigates the bug introduced by the earlier commit, ensuring stability for Xen PV configurations.

Link: http://lkml.kernel.org/r/20180216154101.22865-1-jgross@suse.com

Signed-off-by: Juergen Gross <jgross@suse.com>
Reviewed-by: Pavel Tatashin <pasha.tatashin@oracle.com>

Here is the root cause:
The bug is caused by the change in behavior from commit f7f99100d8d9, which stopped zeroing memory during allocation in `vmemmap`. This change led to the "Pinned" information in the `struct page` of early page tables being lost for Xen PV domains. As a result, the kernel attempted to write directly into the page tables instead of using the hypervisor, leading to a kernel crash due to an invalid memory access.

Here is the patch:
 #include <linux/sort.h>
 #include <linux/pfn.h>
+#include <xen/xen.h>
 #include <linux/backing-dev.h>
 #include <linux/fault-inject.h>
  */
 static inline bool update_defer_init(pg_data_t *pgdat,
 				unsigned long pfn, unsigned long zone_end,
 				unsigned long *nr_initialised)
 {
 	/* Always populate low zones for address-constrained allocations */
 	if (zone_end < pgdat_end_pfn(pgdat))
 		return true;
+	/* Xen PV domains need page structures early */
+	if (xen_pv_domain())
+		return true;
 	(*nr_initialised)++;
 	if ((*nr_initialised > pgdat->static_init_pgcnt) &&
 	    (pfn & (PAGES_PER_SECTION - 1)) == 0) {
 		pgdat->first_deferred_pfn = pfn;
 		return false;
 	}
 
 	return true;
 }
 #else
